title: Low-Thrust Orbital Differential Games with Speed Constraint Enforcement Using Cost Weighting
summary: This paper considers the problem of a low-thrust spacecraft pursuit-evasion differential game with an arbitrary terminal relative speed constraint. It addresses the terminal phase of the engagement for two relatively close spacecraft near a circular orbit. The problem is formulated as a linear-quadratic zero-sum differential game, with soft constraints on the terminal relative position and velocity, and running costs on the players' control efforts.
